identificationModule.briefTitle: A Study of Chidamide Combined With Ivonescimab in the Treatment of Advanced Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer (NSCLC) With Acquired Resistance to Immunotherapy and High Yes-associated Protein (YAP) Expression
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Prospective, Single-Arm, Multicenter, Phase II Clinical Study of Chidamide Combined With Ivonescimab in the Treatment of Advanced Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer (NSCLC) With Acquired Resistance to Immunotherapy and High Yes-associated Protein (YAP) Expression

descriptionModule.briefSummary: This is a prospective, single-arm, multi-center, phase II clinical trial to evaluate the efficacy and safety of Chidamide in combination with Ivonescimab in the treatment of advanced non-small cell lung cancer with secondary immune resistance and high YAP protein expression.

armGroups.label: The combination of Chidamide plus Ivonescimab(AK112)
armGroups.description: Participants will take 20 mg of Chidamide by month every 3-4 days on a twice weekly (BIW) schedule and Ivonescimab (AK112) 20 mg/kg intravenously (IV) Q3W.
interventionNames: Drug: Chidamide in combination with Ivonescimab

interventions.name: Chidamide in combination with Ivonescimab
interventions.description: Chidamide 20mg/dose orally BIW; Ivonescimab 20mg/kg intravenously (IV) Q3W
armGroupLabels: The combination of Chidamide plus Ivonescimab(AK112)

primaryOutcomes.measure: Progression Free Survival(PFS) per Response Evaluation Criteria in Solid tumors (RECIST) v1.1
primaryOutcomes.description: PFS is measured from the start of treatment until progression or death, whichever is first met
primaryOutcomes.timeFrame: From the start of treatment until disease progression or death (assessed up to 24 months)

secondaryOutcomes.description: ORR is defined as percentage of participants with Complete Response(CR) and Partial Response(PR), assessed by the investigators according to the RECIST 1.1.
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: Every 6 weeks (RECIST 1.1) until progression(up to 24 months)

secondaryOutcomes.description: DCR based on RECIST 1.1 assessed by the investigators, the proportion(%) of patients with at least one visit response of CR or PR, or SD.
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: From the first dose of study drug to the first date of documentation of disease progression or death whichever occurred first, up to approximately 2 years

secondaryOutcomes.description: DOR is defined as the time from the first documentation of CR or PR to the date of first documentation of PD or death (whichever occurred first) in participants with confirmed CR or PR based on RECIST 1.1 assessed by investigators.
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: From date of first documented confirmed CR or PR until date of first documentation of PD or death whichever occurred first, up to approximately 2 years

secondaryOutcomes.description: Overall Survival(OS) was measured from the date of first dose of study drug until date of death from any cause. Participants who were lost to follow-up and the participants who alive at the date of data cutoff was censored at the date the participant was last known alive, whichever came earlier.
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: From the date of first dose of study drug until date of death from any cause (up to approximately 5 years).

secondaryOutcomes.description: The incidence of hematological and non-hematological adverse events, events will be classified according to CTCAE v5.0
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: From first dose until 30 days after the last dose, up to approximately 2 years
